originality.rationale: The new assertion is an all-size complete-forcing edge-subset classification and exact polynomial for crown graphs. The earlier 2023 dense balanced bipartite result dominates the scalar minimum only, which is expressly disclaimed as new; publicly available material does not exhibit an all-set classification. The full 2024 arXiv primary was compared and gives general bounds/criterion, not the distribution. Bibliographic and semantic alias/equivalence searches did not identify a broader theorem implying the new polynomial. Residual access risk is recorded and not treated as negative evidence.
residual_risks: The subscription-only full text of He and Zhang (2023), an especially close primary source, was not inspectable beyond its abstract and one-page preview; a hidden all-set statement is possible.
Historical equivalence to nonindexed work using different global/perfect-matching forcing terminology cannot be ruled out.
Self-review are not an independent scientific audit.

value.rationale: Complete forcing is a well motivated perfect-matching uniqueness condition. The new polynomial counts every complete forcing edge subset by size (far more than an optimum) for a standard infinite family, with a sharp orders four/five change in permitted directed cycles and exact minimum-set multiplicities. A full symbolic distribution has mathematical enumerative and probabilistic uses and is not implied by the previously known scalar minimum.
